required_actual_fields: producer receipt.output_root containing the generated XML
ROOT244 rigid proof and ROOT252 continuous-owner proof edges
identity_gate.source_xml_and_generation_input: retain actual paths/hashes from producer request/receipt; no inferred CURRENT identity

case_mapping.mapping_scope: domain label only; it cannot manufacture physical_case_id

native_scope.optional_missing: UNKNOWN; no XML value or zero substitution
native_scope.source_integrity: pre-SHA/stat before decoder and post-SHA/stat after decoder; decoder exception remains primary
native_scope.vtk_scope: Fluid/Bound point-count and finite envelope diagnostic only; no flux/no-penetration credit

source_read_scope.builder: small proof/report/receipt/XML metadata and deferred-file stat only
source_read_scope.valid_case_worker: one frame-0 BI4 plus Fluid/Bound VTK per valid case under parent guard

negative_cases: coarse receipt missing physical_case_id -> per-case UNKNOWN
wrong producer case_id/attempt_id -> per-case FAILED identity join
generated XML path or SHA not joined to receipt/output root -> per-case FAILED
physical identity changed to a sentinel label -> reject; never promote
